info.name: Diffusion API — Administration & Referentials
info.description:
Users, roles, permissions, delegations, and the business referentials (sites, categories, projects, types, natures, canaux, correspondents).

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner: "0. Setup" logs in and captures ids, then each folder creates its own fixtures, asserts the rules, and cleans up after itself.

Everything here needs an administrator account (ADMIN_MANAGE_USERS / ROLES / SITES / CATEGORIES / REFERENTIALS).
